severity_scale.S1: data loss / silent wrong output / no keyboard path
severity_scale.S2: unusable in a supported theme or size

notes: Until the owner decides, every rule has enforced:false (reported only). enforceable:true marks rules whose source is verified, a decision id or an audience rule the owner confirmed.
measure is tool:<check> (a function in tools/ui_measure.py, one TSV row per widget) or manual (not in the TSV). A rule with rows_under shares the check of that rule and writes no rows of its own.

HIG rows keep their paraphrase, Apple URL and verified flag from .claude/gorevler/hig-rules.json; reconcile is same / differs / owner / n-a against our decisions (Fluent 2 direction A and D1-D13 win over HIG).
HIG-WIN-22 is the one row whose Apple page does not state the rule (verified:false); it can never be enforced.

rules.rule: Text is never smaller than the caption floor, scaled with the text size
rules.what: font pixel size of every widget with text

rules.rule: Only the type ramp sizes are used (caption, body, section, panel, page)
rules.what: font pixel size of every widget with text

rules.rule: Text uses the Inter stack: Inter, Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, sans-serif
rules.what: requested font family of every widget with text
rules.value: Inter | Segoe UI Variable Text | Segoe UI | sans-serif

rules.rule: Body and table text has at least 7:1 contrast against its background
rules.what: contrast ratio of sampled text colour vs sampled background (role body: not the text-2 colour)

rules.rule: Secondary text (text-2 colour) has at least 4.5:1 contrast against its background
rules.what: contrast ratio of sampled text colour vs sampled background (role secondary: the text-2 colour)

rules.rule: Component edges, icons and the focus ring have at least 3:1 contrast
rules.what: token pairs per theme (tests/ui/test_tokens.py); not read from widgets

rules.rule: Every clickable widget is at least 24 px in both directions (mouse target)
rules.what: min(width, height) of buttons, combo boxes, spin boxes, sliders, tab bars, line edits

rules.rule: Buttons are at least 28 px high, and at least the control height of the chosen density (D5)
rules.what: height of every button (not check or radio boxes)
rules.value: 28 px, or the D5 control-h of the chosen density (28 / 32 / 40) when larger; not scaled by text size

rules.rule: Controls inside rows are at least 32 px high, and at least the density's control height (D5)
rules.what: height of clickable widgets inside an item view or a widget whose class ends in Row
rules.value: 32 px, or control-h 28 / 32 / 40 by density when larger

rules.rule: Every clickable widget can take keyboard focus (or has a shortcut that does the same)
rules.what: focus policy of every enabled clickable widget; exemptions are reported as skip
rules.note: Exempt (skip): window caption buttons (Alt+Space opens the window menu with the same actions) and the built-in clear action of a QLineEdit (Esc, or select and Delete, do the same)

rules.rule: Every function can be used with the keyboard alone
rules.what: keyboard walkthrough (.claude/skills/ui-bug-hunt/keywalk.py) and the shortcut table
rules.source: PRODUCT.md (every frequent action reachable by keyboard)

rules.rule: Every focusable widget has an accessible name, text or tooltip
rules.what: accessibleName, then text, then tooltip of every enabled focusable widget
rules.value: one of the three is non-empty

rules.rule: Every rule holds at text size 150 % as at 100 %
rules.what: the tool run at text 100 and 150 on every tab and theme

rules.rule: The window fits 1366x768: minimum size no larger, and it takes the size asked
rules.what: minimumSizeHint and actual size of the main window

rules.rule: No window-sized scroll area shows a scroll bar (long lists may scroll)
rules.what: visible scroll bars on non-list scroll areas covering half the window or more
rules.source: PRODUCT.md (1366x768, no window scroll); DESIGN.md Layout

rules.rule: Every focusable widget shows the focus ring (2 px outer + 1 px inner) on keyboard focus
rules.what: ring overlay after Tab-focusing the widget: target, visible, ring width

rules.rule: Layout margins are on the 4 px grid (a 1 px inset under a card stroke is allowed)
rules.what: contents margins of every widget's layout that applies them (stacked pages and the main window's layout are skipped)
rules.source: decisions.md#D6; approved direction A (decisions.md: A supersedes D6)

rules.rule: Spacing between neighbours comes from the D6 scale, plus A's 2 px and 6 px gaps
rules.what: the gap between visible neighbours of a layout (the smaller of the real gap and the declared spacing); layouts with fewer than two visible items or a stacked page are skipped
rules.value: 0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48 px (D6) and 2, 6 px (A: command bar and tabs 2, icon-text 6)

rules.rule: Corner radii in style sheets are 2, 4 or 8 px, plus A's 3 px rider radius; circles and pills are exempt
rules.what: border-radius in the application and widget style sheets, except radii of half the box or more (circles, pills); painted radii: manual
rules.value: 0, 2, 4, 8 px (D6) and 3 px (A: rider and tab)

rules.rule: Animation durations are 0, 80, 120, 180 or 240 ms
rules.what: unit test, not a window probe: tests/ui/test_ui_measure.py::test_motion_duration_tokens (motion.Duration is exactly the D7 set, motion.duration() rejects any other value)
rules.note: Animations are made on demand and deleted when they stop (motion.animate), so the measured window never holds one; the tool had no row for this rule in any run.

rules.rule: No motion on repeated actions; reduced motion is honoured
rules.what: arrow-key and accept-next paths; reduced-motion flag

rules.rule: Icons on buttons are 16, 20 or 24 px
rules.what: iconSize of every button with an icon

rules.rule: Light, dark and high contrast all work; the matrix runs every theme
rules.what: screenshots matrix and this tool run per theme

rules.rule: Cabinet green is the accent, manila marks documents, orange only means kontrol
Office-class Fluent proportions: command bar per tab, quiet surfaces, 1 px hairlines, one accent
Default control size on macOS is 28x28 pt; smallest allowed is 20x20 pt
rules.locator: Accessibility > default and minimum control size table
rules.ours: Owner: 24 px min target; buttons 32 px at Normal (D5: 28/32/40), 28 px floor
rules.note: Our 24 px floor is above HIG 20 px; HIG's 28 px default is not our target, D5's 32 px applies

rules.rule: Apple: minimum button target 44x44 pt (touch, pointer, eyes, remote)
rules.locator: Buttons > Make buttons easy for people to use
rules.ours: 24 px min, 32 px in rows, 28 px button
rules.note: Touch-sized; owner rule says mouse app, 44 pt does not apply

rules.rule: About 12 pt padding around bezelled controls, about 24 pt around controls without a bezel
rules.locator: Accessibility > spacing between controls paragraph
rules.note: Values exist in our scale but we use 4-8 px between toolbar buttons; owner decides: keep 8 px between 36 px icon buttons (A) or widen to 12

rules.rule: Image buttons keep about 10 px padding between image and button edge
rules.locator: Buttons > macOS image button padding
rules.ours: Icon 16/20 in 36 px button = 8-10 px inset
rules.note: Close enough; icon buttons per A deviation 5

rules.rule: Use consistent spacing so content reads as a grid and is easy to scan
rules.value: all gaps from a fixed set
rules.locator: Layout > Use consistent spacing

rules.rule: Place the most important content first in reading order (top to bottom, leading to trailing)
rules.locator: Layout > Order content by relative importance
rules.ours: Reading order; focus order follows it (D11)
rules.note: Qt tab order = reading order check

rules.rule: Evenly space stacked text fields so each label clearly belongs to its field
rules.what: vertical gap between label+field groups equal
rules.locator: Text fields > Evenly space multiple text fields
rules.ours: D6 spacing, 12 or 16 px between field groups

rules.rule: Window layout adapts fluidly to resizing; set min and max window sizes to avoid overlap
rules.what: window.minimumSize, no clipped widgets at min size
rules.locator: Windows > adapt fluidly to different sizes

rules.rule: Every custom button has a visible pressed state
rules.locator: Buttons > Always include a press state

rules.rule: Use style, not size, to mark the preferred choice among buttons; equal options share size
rules.what: widths/heights of sibling buttons in one row
rules.value: same height; preferred differs by fill
rules.locator: Buttons > Use style, not size
rules.ours: 32 px height at Normal (D5), 28 px owner floor; primary = accent fill

rules.rule: Primary role goes to the likeliest non-destructive button and answers Return
rules.locator: Buttons > Assign the primary role
rules.note: Never default on destructive action

rules.rule: Never make a destructive action the primary/default button
rules.locator: Buttons > Do not assign primary to destructive
rules.ours: Deleting is undoable, no confirm button needed

rules.rule: Push button title ends with an ellipsis when it opens more UI to collect input
rules.locator: Buttons > macOS push button, trailing ellipsis

rules.rule: Buttons offer a tooltip on hover for icon-only buttons
rules.locator: Buttons > macOS and visionOS tooltip
rules.ours: Icon-first command bar: every icon button needs a tooltip + accessible name

rules.rule: Show an activity indicator inside a button for actions that do not finish instantly
rules.locator: Buttons > activity indicator in button
rules.note: Options: spinner in button, or status-bar progress only

rules.rule: Toggle states must differ obviously (fill, checkmark or dot), not by subtle tint
rules.locator: Toggles > visual differences obvious

rules.rule: Show unavailable menu items dimmed and unresponsive; keep the menu itself openable
rules.what: disabled item has reduced contrast but readable
rules.locator: Menus > Show people when an item is unavailable
rules.note: D10 does not state a disabled floor

rules.rule: Text field placeholder is a hint only, not a label (it vanishes)
rules.locator: Text fields > Show a hint
rules.ours: Label above field; placeholder secondary text >=4.5:1

rules.rule: Match text field width to expected amount of text
rules.locator: Text fields > match the size

rules.rule: Search fields: placeholder states scope, clear button, search as you type
rules.what: search field has placeholder and clear button
rules.locator: Search fields > placeholder, search immediately

rules.rule: Focus must be visible so people know which item their input targets
rules.what: focus indicator present on every focusable widget
rules.locator: Focus and selection intro
rules.ours: D11: 2 px outer + 1 px inner ring, never hidden

rules.rule: Do not move focus without a user action (exception: directional key navigation)
rules.what: manual: focus change events only after input
rules.locator: Best practices > Avoid changing focus without interaction
rules.ours: Accept-next moves selection by key only; dialogs focus first control

rules.rule: Use a focus ring for text fields; use a full-row highlight for lists and collections
rules.locator: Best practices > use a focus ring for a text field
rules.ours: D11 ring on every focusable widget; rows get a selection fill plus ring
rules.note: List rows: keep fill highlight, ring on the list viewport/current row

rules.rule: Focused list item: accent-colour background with light text; unfocused selection: gray background, standard text
rules.locator: Best practices > Indicate focus consistently
rules.ours: Accent #3f5a4c; inactive-selection colour not yet decided
rules.note: Options: gray (HIG) or 20 % accent tint

rules.rule: Focus may select an item too, unless selecting would switch the view or context
rules.locator: Focus and selection intro
rules.ours: Arrow keys move selection in Kontrol; Enter acts

rules.rule: Full keyboard access: every control reachable and operable by keyboard alone
rules.what: tab order covers all enabled widgets
rules.locator: Keyboards > Support Full Keyboard Access

rules.rule: Respect standard shortcuts (copy, paste, undo, save); add custom ones only when needed
rules.what: shortcut table has no conflicts with standard keys
rules.locator: Keyboards > Respect standard keyboard shortcuts
rules.ours: Windows: Ctrl instead of Cmd; I key unreliable on Turkish layout
rules.note: Use Windows equivalents; shortcut-audit skill

rules.rule: Tab moves between focus groups; arrow keys move within a group
rules.locator: iPadOS > Tab key moves focus among focus groups
rules.ours: Tabs Ctrl+1-6, arrows inside Kontrol timeline

rules.rule: macOS default text size 13 pt; minimum 10 pt
rules.what: font pixel/point size of every label
rules.locator: Typography > Ensuring legibility table, macOS row
rules.ours: Body 15 px, caption 13 px is the floor (D4)
rules.note: Ours is larger for weaker eyesight; 13 px caption is above HIG 10 pt floor

rules.rule: macOS text styles step down from Large Title 26 pt to Body 13 pt
rules.locator: Typography > macOS built-in text styles table
rules.note: Own scale; ramp rule (few steps) kept

rules.rule: Avoid ultralight, thin and light weights; use Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold
rules.locator: Typography > avoid light font weights

rules.rule: Use weight, size and colour to show hierarchy and keep it when text size changes
rules.locator: Typography > Conveying hierarchy

rules.rule: Use few typefaces
rules.what: count of font families in app
rules.locator: Typography > Minimize the number of typefaces

rules.rule: Custom fonts must stay legible at the recommended minimum sizes
rules.locator: Typography > Make sure custom fonts are legible

rules.rule: Keep truncation low as text grows; avoid truncating in scrollable regions
rules.what: elided text in labels, buttons, combo boxes and table cells (cells as in screenshots._cells)
rules.locator: Typography > Keep text truncation to a minimum
rules.ours: Clipping check at 150 % text; overflow menu for tabs (owner answer)

rules.rule: Small text needs 4.5:1 contrast; 18 pt and bold text need 3:1
rules.locator: Accessibility > minimum contrast ratio table
rules.note: Ours is stricter than HIG

rules.rule: Check contrast in light and dark modes; offer more when Increase Contrast is on
rules.locator: Accessibility > contrast, Dark Mode check
rules.ours: D9/D10 per token pair per theme; High contrast theme

rules.rule: Do not rely on colour alone to convey meaning (colour-blind users)
rules.locator: Color > avoid colors that hinder perception
rules.ours: Orange = kontrol also has label and icon status vocabulary

rules.rule: Avoid similar colours between control labels and a colourful background
rules.what: contrast of secondary (text-2) text against neutral surfaces, shared with DEC-CON-02; labels on coloured fills are counted under DEC-CON-01
rules.value: >=4.5:1 (the number is from the Accessibility page; the Color page gives none)
rules.locator: Color > control labels; Accessibility > contrast ratio table

rules.rule: Do not offer an app-specific light/dark setting; follow system appearance
rules.locator: Dark Mode > Avoid an app-specific appearance setting
rules.ours: Follows OS by default, manual override in Ayarlar (D9)
rules.note: Override kept: Windows lacks per-app theme; HIG advice not followed on purpose

rules.rule: App must look good in both appearances including with Increase Contrast
rules.locator: Dark Mode > Ensure your app looks good in both modes

rules.rule: Accent colour applies to buttons, selection highlight and sidebar icons
rules.what: accent token used for these only
rules.locator: Color > macOS accent colour paragraph
rules.ours: Cabinet green accent; orange only for kontrol (D1)

rules.rule: Add motion purposefully; do not animate just for decoration
rules.locator: Motion > Add motion purposefully

rules.rule: Avoid motion on frequent UI interactions
rules.locator: Motion > avoid adding motion to frequent interactions
rules.ours: D7: no motion on arrow keys, accept-next

rules.rule: Do not make people wait for an animation; let them cancel it
rules.locator: Motion > Let people cancel motion

rules.rule: Feedback animations should be brief and precise
rules.locator: Motion > Aim for brevity and precision
rules.note: HIG sets no millisecond values; ours are Fluent-derived. Checked by the unit test of DEC-MOT-01, not by the tool

rules.rule: Make motion optional: honour Reduce Motion; replace large movement with fades
rules.locator: Accessibility > Reduce Motion paragraph

rules.rule: Avoid auto-dismissing, time-boxed UI where people need more time
rules.what: toasts/banners without timers for critical info
rules.locator: Accessibility > Minimize time-boxed elements
rules.note: Options: toasts persist until dismissed, or 6+ s with hover-pause and log entry

rules.rule: Use determinate progress when possible; indeterminate only when unknown
rules.what: progress widgets with known totals use range
rules.locator: Progress indicators > use a determinate indicator
rules.ours: Indeterminate progress exempt from 240 ms cap (D7)

rules.rule: Interface icons are simple, one concept, consistent size, detail and stroke weight
rules.locator: Icons > Maintain visual consistency

rules.rule: Match icon weight to adjacent text weight
rules.locator: Icons > match the weights of icons and adjacent text
rules.ours: Lucide stroke tuned to Inter Regular/Medium (D8)

rules.rule: Use familiar icons for familiar actions; standard icons for share, print, search
rules.locator: Buttons > associate familiar actions with familiar icons

rules.rule: Provide icons for all items in a menu group or for none
rules.what: menu items in group all have icon or none
rules.locator: Menus > uniform visual treatment across items

rules.rule: Use icons sparingly in menus
rules.locator: Menus > Use menu item icons sparingly

rules.rule: Document icon sizes: 16, 32, 128, 256, 512 px with @2x variants
rules.locator: Icons > document icon size list (macOS)
rules.note: Options: ship 16/24/32/48/256 .ico; HIG macOS list not applicable

rules.rule: Do not build custom window frames or controls that imitate the system
rules.locator: Windows > Avoid creating custom window UI
rules.ours: Custom Mica title band with tabs (direction A)
rules.note: Owner chose A; frame must still keep Windows min/max/close and snap behaviour

rules.rule: Window controls must not overlap toolbar items at the leading edge
rules.what: hit test of title-band items vs caption buttons
rules.locator: Windows > window controls do not overlap toolbar items
rules.ours: Windows caption buttons are at trailing edge
rules.note: macOS traffic lights sit leading; our rule: keep clear of min/max/close

rules.rule: Key and inactive windows look different
rules.locator: Windows > main, key, inactive appearances
rules.note: Options: dim title band when inactive (Fluent does) or leave unchanged

rules.rule: Do not put critical actions in a bottom bar of a window
rules.locator: Windows > avoid critical info in bottom bar
rules.ours: Status bar holds zoom slider only; main action in command bar
rules.note: Status bar has non-critical info; OK

rules.rule: Window title: useful, short (about 15 characters or fewer), not the app name
rules.locator: Toolbars > Write a concise title
rules.note: Elide with tooltip; no 15-char cap enforced

rules.rule: Do not add an overflow menu by hand and avoid layouts that overflow by default
rules.locator: Toolbars > overflow menu is automatic

rules.rule: Keep toolbar items few and clear; prefer symbols without borders
rules.locator: Toolbars > choose items deliberately; borderless symbols
rules.ours: Icon-first command bar, 36 px buttons in 44 px bar

rules.rule: Menu item labels: verb phrase, title-style capitalisation, no articles
rules.locator: Menus > write a label that describes the action
rules.note: Turkish has no title-case convention

rules.rule: Menu item ends with "…" when more input is needed
rules.locator: Menus > Append an ellipsis

rules.rule: Keep menus short; use submenus sparingly, one level, about 5 items or fewer
rules.locator: Menus > Limit depth and length of submenus
rules.ours: Menus open via Alt+key, ≡ and Ctrl+K

rules.rule: Group related items with separators; frequent items first
rules.locator: Menus > Prefer frequent items first, group related

rules.rule: Show the keyboard shortcut next to the menu item
rules.locator: Menus > menu item displays keyboard command

rules.rule: Menu bar: always show the same items; disable instead of hiding
rules.locator: Menu bar > menu items stay the same
rules.ours: No resting menu row; menus appear on Alt (A deviation 1)
rules.note: Item set kept constant, disabled not hidden

rules.rule: Menu bar: standard menu order and standard shortcuts
rules.locator: Menu bar > Support the default system-defined menus
rules.note: Options: keep our own order or map to File/Edit/View/Window/Help in Turkish

rules.rule: Alerts: title, optional text, up to three buttons, trailing default, no bare OK
rules.locator: Alerts > Place buttons where people expect
rules.ours: Windows/Fluent button order for the default button (Fluent wins)
rules.note: Count and no-bare-OK rule kept; trailing placement follows Fluent convention

rules.rule: Cancel alerts with Escape; destructive alert always has "Cancel"
rules.locator: Alerts > Provide alternative ways to cancel

rules.rule: Do not alert for common undoable actions; do not use alerts for plain information
rules.locator: Alerts > Avoid alerts for common, undoable actions
rules.ours: Delete is undoable via Ctrl+Z (owner answer)

rules.rule: Sheets are modal on macOS and scoped to the parent task
rules.locator: Sheets > In macOS a sheet is always modal

rules.rule: Undo and redo: allow unlimited undo, show what the undo changed, name the action
rules.what: undo stack depth; undo shows result
rules.locator: Undo and redo > Let people undo multiple times
rules.ours: Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y, item names the count

rules.rule: Show status feedback near the thing it describes; keep it passive unless critical
rules.locator: Feedback > integrate status feedback

rules.rule: Sidebar: group hierarchy with disclosure controls, familiar symbols
rules.locator: Sidebars > group hierarchy with disclosure controls
rules.ours: No sidebar in main nav; inspector uses cards
rules.note: We use tabs plus inspector, no navigation sidebar

rules.rule: Lists: give clear selection feedback; multi-select with keyboard is expected
rules.note: Page confirms selection feedback; the keyboard multi-select part is not stated there

rules.rule: Touch-only guidance (touch size, gestures, Dynamic Type) does not apply: macOS has no Dynamic Type
rules.locator: Typography > macOS: no Dynamic Type
rules.note: macOS lacks Dynamic Type; our setting replaces it
